trigger: Between night 2 and 3: Kessler's Remnant at the gate.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Day. Two Humvees and an MRAP on the access road, flying a flag gone grey. Major Dale Kessler, on foot.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: Pearce. Dale Kessler. I've got forty-one soldiers, no fuel, and orders from nobody. I need your heat.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: Sergeant Ruiz tells me you're the kind who opens doors. So. I'm asking. Not ordering. I'm tired of ordering.

choices.text: Lay down arms. Come in. Work.
Your soldiers come in. You don't.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: ...Done. God. Done. You'll want my generator mechanics. And my floodlights. I have floodlights.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: Fair. Fair. I'd have done the same. Take care of them.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: Then I'm sorry. Nobody wins this one.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A short, stupid fight in the snow. When it's over, the Remnant is gone. So are three of yours.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: In the back of the MRAP: the Remnant's prisoners. Hands bound. Frostbitten.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Wes. Thinner. Alive. He looks at you like he's not sure you're real.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Tonight's the third night. Everyone knows it. Nobody says it.
